items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.7 Flash, a cheaper model built for coding and AI agents
items.note: Beats comparable Anthropic and OpenAI models on 9 benchmarks, priced at $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through year-end

items.title: xAI co-founder's River AI raises $1.1B to build an open-weight AI stack
items.note: General Catalyst and AMP PBC lead the round, with Nvidia and AMD Ventures joining just two months after the company's founding

items.title: Louisiana's new wholesaling law takes effect, adding disclosure and cancellation rules
items.note: Act 807 requires wholesalers to disclose their status, give sellers a cancellation window, and escrow deposits or face AG enforcement

items.title: Mortgage rates dip to 6.67%, second straight weekly decline
items.note: 30-year fixed rate eased from 6.69% as purchase and refinance applications tick up

items.title: Corma raises $60M seed to build an AI model that fights AI-powered cyberattacks
items.note: Sequoia-led round for the Tel Aviv and San Francisco startup, which cut threat-response times over 94% in early deployments
